verdict.rationale: kitty documents its own shell integration for zsh, fish and bash with command-aware features: jumping to previous prompts, viewing the last command's output in less, and mouse cursor movement at prompts. The ssh kitten also sets up shell integration automatically on remote hosts. None of the story's named examples (exit status, duration, completion notifications) appear in the evidence, so only the general command-aware core is supported. Missing for 10: evidence of exit-status tracking, command duration, notifications when long commands finish, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
